[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. Thank you for all your help.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]You might run into someone[XENO:n ]
called Vanea in the capital.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Just mention my name and she'll lend a hand.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Vanea...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Is she a Machina as well?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]She's my daughter. She won't be far from Egil.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Hold on. You mean she's Egil's younger sister?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You've got it, lad.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And you say she'll help us?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]The girl doesn't want to hurt Egil,[XENO:n ]
but she doesn't like what he's doing.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]
She should be a big help to you young 'uns.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I dunno why she'd help us, but...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]We'll try and find her when we get there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT3 ]Good luck.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Fiorung, don't forget. I've only[XENO:n ]
made temporary repairs.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I think you should be able to fight[XENO:n ]
but don't overdo it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

Come and see me the moment you experience[XENO:n ]
any further system failure.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT1 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I will. Thank you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]In the meantime, I'm hoping I'll find a way to[XENO:n ]
restore your former body.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Is that possible?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Theoretically, it might be possible to use your genetic[XENO:n ]
information to regenerate your missing organs.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]Sorry. It's unfair for me to give you hope.[XENO:n ]
To be honest, there's very little chance.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]But if there's even the slightest[XENO:n ]
possibility, I have to try.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Thank you, Linada![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Fiorung...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Don't make that face! OK, let's go![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Off ya go, kid.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I'm counting on you and the Monado.[XENO:n ]
